description: On a dynaset and then a snapshot over F: walk ID and Bookmark of all rows to EOF; then for each of Move(0, b2), Move(1, b2), Move(-1, b2), Move(-3, b2), Move(20, b0), Move(0, b7), Move(0, b8), and Move(1, X) for X = empty byte array, four zero bytes, empty string, Long 1, Null, Empty and Missing: MoveFirst, call Move with the StartBookmark, read BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition, ID and Bookmark. bi is the four-byte constant (i, 2, 0, 0) for the dynaset and (i, 3, 0, 0) for the snapshot (the byte pattern of the first rows in the retained id-bookmark-shape capture; the bookmarks read by the walk show what this copy actually returns). Asks how a start bookmark and a count combine, what is refused (empty, malformed, past-the-end bookmark), and whether a bookmark constant read elsewhere resolves. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
